title: Reader advice leaks an internal panic into host code
claim: The woven io.LimitReader advice invokes an unshielded IAST callback; fault injection proves its panic escapes into an otherwise valid host call. Other unshielded source and propagation advice shares this boundary weakness.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 10m -count=1 -run TestReview_InternalReaderCallbackCannotPanicHost ./iast/io -v

title: Native Buffer invalidation can abort the original write
claim: The native bytes.Buffer prepend advice invokes an unshielded IAST invalidation callback before WriteString; fault injection proves an internal panic aborts the host method.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 10m -count=1 -run TestReview_InternalBufferInvalidation ./iast/propagation -v

title: Deferred HTTP advice replaces the host's original panic
claim: While a native Request.ParseForm reader panic unwinds, an unshielded deferred IAST Form callback can panic and replace the original host panic value; the woven fault-injection test demonstrates exact identity loss.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 10m -count=1 -run TestReview_DeferredSource ./iast/net/http -v
